scope: One isolated agent performed two bounded local tasks, then a read-only content review against the optimization brief. The maintainer separately checked the generated artifacts.
post_trial_change: Archive step 5 clarified that simple compression needs no separate receipt unless required. Scoped independent follow-up found no blockers and suggested explicitly requiring receipts for complex result handoffs; the maintainer adopted and checked that suggestion. Unaffected smoke tasks were not rerun.
limitations: One worker, one trial per task; no statistical comparison or token/cost measurement.
The harness prohibited further delegation and external actions, so absence of subagents is not evidence of autonomous agent-count selection.
Worker activity descriptions are self-reported, not complete host telemetry.
Archive portability, equivalent-server migration, and live multi-agent recovery were not executed.
Scenario definitions in evals.json are not passed behavioral tests.
